srcline: Sourced reporting · DDC, PCD and provincial health offices as carried by the press
chartSub: Disease reports, warnings, air quality and local incidents by month.
status: A curated record, not a surveillance feed. 44 records for Jan–Sep 2026. Most are national year-to-date disease totals with no place on the map. There are no reports of hospital strain, livestock disease or mosquito surveillance.
notes: Disease totals are claims by the DDC. Case and death counts are year-to-date figures as reported, not events. Later records supersede earlier ones for the same disease, so they must not be added together.
Air quality units differ. Most readings are PM2.5 in µg/m³ from the Pollution Control Department. IQAir readings are US AQI lower bounds. The two scales cannot be compared directly.
Hospital strain has no records. No 2026 report of an overwhelmed hospital could be found and opened, so the Hospital overwhelmed alert still waits for a feed.
Figures to treat with care. The Covid and flu totals in the 15 Sep record may be year-to-date. The mpox count of 139 is for 2026; another outlet's 1,074 is cumulative since 2022.
Nationwide records have no marker. Regional air readings without a named province are listed but not mapped.
